column1: # Hand verdicts for the passages whose flag status changed with the new safety stems
# (docs/reports/voa-safety-stems.md). Each passage was read with the evidence of the old stems.
# Columns: id, category, rule, verdict, final, note.
# verdict: correct = the passage is not substantially about the category (the flag was a false alarm);
#   borderline = a reader could go either way; wrong = the flag should have stayed.
# final: removed = the flag is gone under the stems in this change; restored = the first set of stems
#   removed it wrongly, and a narrower stem brings it back. Rule: the flag rule that showed the change.
# default: all 82 flags the first set of stems removed. strict and loose: only the passages the default
#   read did not cover (5 and 89); the 87 loose ones not listed were read and are correct.
